description: Synthetic matcher cases. Each case first saves its setup assignments the way the Review screen does (resolve, then saveConfirmedAssignment), then runs matcher.match on the input. expected is the intended group: matched, review (matcher status unmatched) or ambiguous. Current behavior is recorded as-is, including wrong answers.
